## v0.1.0.9007 (current dev)

### New features

- Fan-out tables (one file split into several output tables) declare their
  outputs under a new `outputs:` key in `schema.yaml`: a description and
  versioned tidy columns per output, `raw` optional, and `shape: 'subset'` for
  outputs whose columns depend on the data. `Tool` checks every fan-out
  `tidy_*()` result against them: all declared outputs returned, each with the
  columns (in order) and types of one of its schema versions. Outputs are
  written as `<tool>_<output>`. A fan-out table read by its own
  `parse_<table>()` may omit `columns:`.
- `nemoverse_wf_dispatch()` now includes `tidydragen`.
- CLI `tidy` gains `--dbhost`/`--dbport`, and its database writes run in a
  single transaction.
- `list_files_dir()` follows symlinks (keeping the link name) and drops broken
  ones.
- `nemo_schema_reactable()` rewritten on native reactable row details: search
  now matches column names and globs, expanded rows show a per-version
  column-presence matrix, and the table follows light/dark page themes. Outputs
  are listed after their file table, tagged "parent of"/"child of" in the
  description (and in the Glob column for outputs), and both the table and its
  expanded column tables number rows in display order (`#`).
  `nemo_schemavis_data()` now returns one row per table with nested columns.
  Tool pills are grey unless coloured via `tool_colours` (a named vector
  supplied by the child package). The widget ships its own CSS so it spans the
  full page width on any pkgdown site.
- Schema-driven S3 sync: each `schema.yaml` table can declare a `glob` of the
  files it needs, and the new `s3sync()` / `nemo.R sync` pull only those files
  for a workflow (`r pr(77)`-`r pr(79)`, `r pr(83)`). `wf_sync_patterns()`
  returns a workflow's include/exclude patterns; `schema_glob_check()` catches
  globs that drift from their table `pattern` (matched via `glob_to_regex()`).
- New `Config` methods `get_outputs()`, `get_table_outputs()` and
  `get_output_shape()`. `get_schemas_raw()`/`get_schemas_tidy()`/
  `get_schemas_both()` include output rows and gain a `parent` column (the file
  table of an output).
- `Tool` errors on construction when a `parse_*()`/`tidy_*()` method matches no
  schema table, instead of a typo'd name silently falling back to the ftype
  default parser.
- `read_parquet_grep()` reads the one parquet file matching a pattern (for
  `@testexamples`).

### Performance

- `Config` memoises schema lookups (`get_schema_raw()`/`get_schema_tidy()`/
  `get_col_map()`), which `Tool` calls per file for renames and fan-out output
  checks.
- `run()` now parses, tidies, and writes one file at a time, so memory scales
  with a single file rather than the whole run (`r pr(82)`).

### Breaking changes

- Output names may not clash with table names, and duplicate output paths now
  error instead of silently overwriting each other.
- `_2`/`_3` prefix numbering for repeated basenames is now ordered by path, so
  output names no longer depend on file listing order.
- `Config` validates required table/column keys on construction, listing every
  problem at once.
- Removed the `csv-nohead-long` ftype (`r pr(80)`).
- `parse_file_keyvalue()` now applies the schema column types instead of
  returning all-character columns (`r pr(84)`), and errors on duplicate keys.
- `nemo_gha_mermaid()` redesigned: now takes the `.github/workflows` dir
  (`nemo_gha_mermaid(here(".github/workflows"))`) instead of
  `actions_url`/`deploy_yaml`. Job edges follow `needs:` (parallel jobs no
  longer drawn as a chain), reusable workflows are read at their pinned `@ref`,
  steps gated on `inputs.*` conditions are dropped or marked `(if)`, each job is
  one compact node listing its steps, and unreadable workflows show as a warning
  node instead of silently vanishing.

### Bug fixes

- Output prefixes no longer collide when one recursive tidy holds repeat runs of
  a sample and a parser matches two basenames reducing to the same prefix (e.g.
  WiGiTS `redux` vs plain `duplicate_freq` files); previously one output
  silently overwrote the other.
- Tools with no sample prefix no longer get a leading `_` in output names.
- Parse/tidy errors name the tool parser and file they came from.
- `NEMO_LOG_LEVEL` is case-insensitive; an invalid value warns and falls back to
  `INFO` instead of breaking package load.
- `dvc_download_file()` verifies the md5 and re-fetches corrupted local copies.

### Infrastructure

- Release deploys (conda, Docker, pkgdown) trigger on `v*` tags only; conda
  lockfiles are published as release assets (`r pr(76)`).

## v0.1.0 (2026-07-28)

Major refactor.

### Breaking changes

**Unified schema format** (`r pr(48)`)

- `schema.yaml` replaces the separate `raw.yaml` + `tidy.yaml` pair per tool.
  Each column now carries `raw`, `tidy`, `type`, `description`, and `versions`
  in one place under a flat `tables:` map. Child packages must migrate their
  per-tool configs to this format.

**Config / Tool / Workflow API overhaul** (`r pr(64)`, `r pr(65)`, `r pr(66)`)

- `Config`: `get_raw_*` / `get_tidy_*` methods renamed (e.g.
  `get_raw_patterns()` → `get_patterns()`, `get_raw_schemas_all()` →
  `get_schemas_raw()`); `are_raw_schemas_valid()` removed (validation now in
  `initialize()`); `config`, `raw_schemas_all`, `tidy_schemas_all` fields moved
  to private; `pkg` added as a public field; `cloneable = FALSE`
- `Tool`: `$files`, `$tbls`, `$files_tbl` moved to private --- use
  `list_files()` / `get_tbls()` instead; schema delegate fields
  (`get_raw_schema`, `get_tidy_schema`) removed --- use
  `tool$config$get_schema_raw()` / `tool$config$get_schema_tidy()`;
  `nemofy(diro = ...)` → `run(output_dir = ...)`; column `group` →
  `prefix_suffix`; `post_process_files` hook (`r pr(70)`) renamed to
  `refine_files` (`r pr(73)`), now applied to the base prefix *before* the
  disambiguation passes so subclasses can fold a semantic distinction (e.g.
  germline/somatic) into the prefix and avoid a spurious `_2`/`_3` suffix;
  `cloneable = FALSE`
- `Workflow`: `$tools`, `$files_tbl` moved to private --- use `get_tools()`;
  `nemofy(diro = ...)` → `run(output_dir = ...)`; `list_files(type = ...)` ---
  `type` arg removed; gains `metapkg` constructor argument; path existence
  validated at construction; `filter_files()` now validates names against known
  `tool_parser` values; `cloneable = FALSE`

**CLI renames**

- `--out_dir` → `--output_dir`; `--pfix_include` → `--prefix_include`; output
  column `input_pfix` → `input_prefix`; `--prefix_include` is now opt-in (no
  longer added by default)

**Other**

- `nemo_metadata()`: parameter `input_dir` => `input_dirs`; return value changed
  from a named list to a single-row tibble with list-columns
- `RPostgres` dropped as a hard dependency - callers now supply `dbdrv`
  explicitly
- `txt` ftypes renamed to `tsv` (`r pr(70)`, `r pr(71)`)

### New features

- New assertion module: `nemo_stop()`, `nemo_assert_scalar_chr()`,
  `nemo_assert_chr()`, `nemo_assert_not_null()`, `nemo_assert_out_fmt()`
  replacing `assertthat` calls
- Schema scaffold helpers: `config_prep_raw_schema()`, `config_prep_raw()`,
  `config_prep_multi()`, `config_prep_write()` --- bootstrap a `schema.yaml`
  from example raw files
- `nemo_gha_mermaid()`: generates a Mermaid flowchart of the full CI/CD pipeline
  (`r pr(52)`)
- `nemo_uml()`: generates a PlantUML SVG from R6 class names
- `nemo_schema_reactable()` / `nemo_schemavis_data()`: interactive schema
  explorer
- New file types: `tsv-nohead`, `tsv-keyvalue`, `csv`, `csv-nohead-long`
- `tidy`: `--output_id` / `--ulid` flags for tagging outputs with a run
  identifier; `--max` flag on `list` subcommand
- Metadata exported to `metadata.parquet` per run (`r pr(62)`, `r iss(61)`)
- `Tool` and `Workflow` now both support `write_metadata` boolean
- `extra_ftypes()` subclass hook for registering pkg-specific ftype parsers
  (`r pr(70)`, `r pr(71)`)
- Add [DVC](https://dvc.org/) support, mostly for child packages (`r pr(69)`)
- New `Output Naming` vignette, shared with child packages via
  `inst/doc-templates/vignettes/_output_naming.qmd` (`r pr(73)`)

### Performance

- File discovery \~20× faster on large directories --- benchmarked at 1.9s =>
  0.1 s on 43k files x 15 patterns

### Infrastructure

- CI/CD: `deploy.yaml` refactored from a 136-line monolith to reusable workflows
  via `tidywf/actions`; now also triggers on `dev` branch pushes
- `@claude` GHA restricted to repo owners, collaborators, and members
- `dependabot.yml` added for automated GHA dependency updates
- conda: aarch64 lock file added; dedicated `bump.yaml` env added
- Panache format vignettes (`r pr(72)`)
